items.title: Fine-Tuning vs. Prompting: How Do You Choose?
items.summary:
Should you improve your prompt—or fine-tune the model?

In this Short, an author of Building Specialized AI Systems explains how to recognize when prompt engineering has reached its limits and fine-tuning is the better approach for your AI system.

Learn more about Building Specialized AI Systems: https://hubs.la/Q04tZN370
